title: Unreal engine 5.8 MCP connected to claude code
author: donkeykong917
selftext:
updated to the last unreal engine 5.8 which shipped with experimental mcp. 

For this demo used UE sample racing game and replace the map with marketplace synthwave assets. 

Now to make a "game"

comments.author: Accomplished-Fan9568
comments.body: Okay so most is assets not made by ai?

replies.author: donkeykong917
replies.body: I bought a asset bundle that came with alot of different maps, decided to just test it with synthwave one. Whether or not ai that's a good question.

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body: Needs more haze (show mostly just emission), drop in saturation in the middle ground a little, Tone down Reflections everywhere with rough patches, different materials... Better definition of road vs sidewalk, etc.

comments.author: UnrelaxedToken
comments.body:
So this is nto a nother ad for higgisfield, you really did make it without connecting bunch of other apis?

Can you explain your process please? WHat version of mcp, prompts? project settings? other prepeations? How long for it to be made? etc

Thanks

replies.author: donkeykong917
replies.body:
1. Update unreal engine to 5.8
2. Install mcp plugin insdie
3. Ask Claude to help me to connect to mcp
4. Load up car racing tutorial 
5. Install assets into project via unreal store, so maps you bought or are free
6. Ask Claude code to change the stage or cycle through what stages.
7. Boom play game.

I probably could if changed the stage myself.

Then later, need to fine tune, make menu blah blah, fine tuning will cost the tokens

comments.author: steb2k
comments.body: so you're just asking claude how to fire up the "UE sample racing game", then remap some assets, and not do any code work?

replies.author: donkeykong917
replies.body:
I manually fired up the smaller car project first. I used Claude to take control of unreal engine to take a existing car from the sample and put it into the synwave city asset pack that I got.

 I think it did some partial code changes regarding using replacing textures that came with the synwave asset pack for the existing car.

Besides that it didn't reinvent the wheel and build stuff from scratch. If I would done it manually,I would of done it in the same method, find samples and combine it into one project. Only write new code if it was missing stuff I couldn't find.
